gen-gf-offside-outfit: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its wide tracking gives the headline a stretched, commanding stance. Outfit follows in sans-serif form, lower and plainer.
gen-gf-offside-plus-jakarta-sans: Commanding and a little theatrical, Offside leads. Plus Jakarta Sans settles underneath as a plain sans with one uniform stroke and curve endings held well apart, so the taller heading letters stand out against its modest lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any pressure swell and its c and s kept widely parted. And Offside, taller and more tracked out above it, gives that tidy plain sans something expressive to stand under.
gen-gf-offside-space-grotesk: Offside stretches its tall, widely tracked letters across the line, curves left stubbornly open. Space Grotesk brings the pair's strongest quality: a hollow, breathing plain sans that lets the heading keep every bit of its swagger.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-amulya: Amulya reads contemporary and modern, with generous gaps left in its curves. Oldenburg is the louder partner, a single-stroke brush look with shallow lowercase, so the plain sans feels like a deep breath after it.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-chillax: Chillax is casual and relaxed, drawn like spaghetti with loops left unfinished. Oldenburg sits above it with a sign-painter's brush look and shallow lowercase, so the two feel like a bold shop sign next to a handwritten note.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-plein: Plein brings a reliable, clean sans-serif voice, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Plein also gives Oldenburg's brush-stroked, shallow-lowercase headings their strongest quality: a distinctive heading with a body that never competes.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-roundo: Roundo reads neutral and geometric, its lowercase n built with arch and stem matching and every small counter left unclogged. Roundo's strongest quality is how readily that plain sans lets Oldenburg's single-stroke brush headings and shallow lowercase take the spotlight.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-spline-sans: Contemporary and approachable, Spline Sans leads with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Underneath Oldenburg's brush-stroked, shallow headings, a longer passage in this plain sans would feel open and unhurried, with every stroke at identical weight.
gen-gf-oldenburg-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable, a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve. And across a longer passage it would stay comfortable, a sans-serif that lets Oldenburg's shallow, brush-stroked headings do the showing off.
